secedgar.description: SEC EDGAR filings, XBRL financials, material events, insider transactions, institutional holdings and beneficial owners
secedgar.instruction: Use for primary-source US disclosure: annual and quarterly reports, 8-K events, proxy statements, XBRL financials, Form 4 insider trades, 13F holdings and 13D/13G owners. Start with secedgar_company_search, then secedgar_search_filings for form types and dates, secedgar_get_filing for a section, and secedgar_get_financials for XBRL facts. Cite the accession number, form type and filing date beside every figure; a filing is the source of record, a summary is not.
